modalities.evidence: the EOG channels from two previous studies were pooled

output.population: 41 participants, ages 18–33: 20 from Jaeger et al. (2020) and 21 from Holtze et al. (2021)
output.summary: Pooled EOG channels from two earlier competing-speaker studies in which participants attended to one of two simultaneously presented audio books across 10-minute blocks, under omnidirectional and beamforming conditions.
